title: Expanding Healthcare Insurance Coverage for Foreign Workers
what_it_is: Expanding Healthcare Insurance Coverage for Foreign Workers

sections.label: Employer costs for foreign workers
sections.summary: Employers must bear foreign workers' medical treatment costs, with insurance covering inpatient care but not outpatient conditions like pulmonary tuberculosis.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Teo Ser Luck) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: Employers of foreign workers, including foreign domestic workers, are required to bear the cost of any medical treatment incurred by their foreign workers (FWs), including pulmonary tuberculosis.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Teo Ser Luck) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: If inpatient or day surgery treatment is required, it will be covered under the medical insurance that employers are required to buy.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Teo Ser Luck) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: The minimum insurance coverage of $15,000 covers 96% of all inpatient and day surgery bills at public hospitals.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Teo Ser Luck) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: However, conditions, such as pulmonary tuberculosis, are often treated without hospitalisation and, thus, not covered by the insurance.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Teo Ser Luck) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: Mandating insurance coverage to include outpatient bills will raise the cost to all employers.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Teo Ser Luck) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: MOM will continue to periodically review and update the healthcare insurance requirements for all foreign workers and foreign domestic workers.

sections.label: Employer responsibility and policy review
sections.summary: Employers remain responsible for covering employees, and authorities will review cases and policies and coverage.

sentences.speaker: Mr Teo Ser Luck
sentences.text: All employers are still responsible to cover for their employees.

sentences.speaker: Mr Teo Ser Luck
sentences.text: And, of course, we encourage all employers to note of such a trend and the cost incurred.

sentences.speaker: Mr Teo Ser Luck
sentences.text: But we will review the cases and see how many of these cases are there and whether it is large and, as such, we will take at look at the policies and the coverage itself.
